answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable quartz-hard stake deposit before it can transact. An honest agent is a lit lantern others willingly vouch for; a thousand fresh fakes are just a dark island nobody attests to. Because each extra identity forfeits real capital when peers slash it for detected collusion, a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly with its size, so buying a fake majority costs the attacker far more than any payout it could ever steal.
